content.text: Oe BAWIPA koe lunghawilawk hah dei awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ama teh ahawi,
a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
BAWIPA ni a ratang tangcoung,
taran kut dawk hoi a ratang e naw ni,
hottelah dei awh naseh.
Kho tangkuem hoi, kanîtho,
kanîloum, aka, atung lahoi koung a pâkhueng.
Thingyeium ramke lamthung dawk a kâva awh teh,
o nahane kho hmawt awh hoeh.
Vonhlam tui kahran hoi a lung apout awh.
Runae koehoi BAWIPA hah a kaw awh teh,
rucatnae thung hoi a rasa awh.
Khosaknae hmuen khopui vah a cei thai awh nahanelah,
lam kalan dawk a hrawi awh.
Oe taminaw niyah BAWIPA hawinae hoi
taminaw hanelah kângairu hno a sak e naw dawkvah,
lunghawilawk dei awh haw boipawiteh khe.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, hringnae ni a rabui e hah kuep sak vaiteh,
vonhlamrincinaw hah hawinae hoi a paha sak han.
Hmonae hoi duenae tâhlip dawk
ka tahung e naw hah,
runae sumrui hoi katek lah ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut lawk a oun, a taran awh teh,
Lathueng Poung e pouknae hai banglah ngâi awh hoeh.
Hatdawkvah, ahnimae lungthin teh
karanglah a tabut sak,
a rawpkhai awh teh,
kabawmkung apihai awm hoeh.
Hottelah runae koehoi BAWIPA a kaw awh teh,
ahni ni amamae rucatnae thung hoi a tâco takhai.
Hmonae hoi duenae tâhlip thung hoi a rasa teh,
ahnimouh kateknae sumbawtarui hah a rading pouh.
Oe taminaw niyah BAWIPA hawinae hoi taminaw
hanelah kângairu hno a sak e naw dawkvah,
lunghawilawk dei awh haw boipawiteh khe.
Ama ni rahum tho hah a raphoe teh,
tarennae sumtaboung hah a raphoe.
Tamipathu hah kâtapoenae hoi
a payonnae dawk runae khang sak lah ao.
A hringnae ni ca hane pueng a panuet teh,
duenae tho koe a pâtam awh.
Hottelah runae koehoi BAWIPA a kaw awh teh,
ahni ni amamae rucatnae thung hoi a tâco takhai.
A lawk patoun lahoi a dam sak teh,
a kahmanae koehoi a rungngang.
Oe taminaw niyah BAWIPA hawinae hoi taminaw
hanelah kângairu hno a sak e naw dawkvah,
lunghawilawk dei awh haw boipawiteh khe.
Lunghawilawkdeinae thuengnae poe laihoi
a tawk e naw hah lunghawi lahoi pâpho naseh.
Talîpui dawk long hoi kahlawng ka cet e,
ka kaw e talîpui dawk hnopai kayawtnaw ni,
kadung poung e tui thung vah,
kângairu hoi BAWIPA hno sak e hah ouk a hmu awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ama ni kâ a poe teh kahlî a tho sak,
hote kahlî ni tuicapa a thaw sak.
Kalvan totouh a luen teh,
adungnae koe bout a bo awh teh,
takithonae dawk a lung a pout awh.
Yamu ka parui e tami patetlah rawrawcu awh teh,
bangtelah o nahan panuek awh hoeh.
Hottelah runae koehoi BAWIPA a kaw awh teh,
ahni ni amamae rucatnae thung hoi a tâco takhai.
Kahlî a roum sak teh,
tuicapa hai a roum.
Hottelah a roum dawkvah, a lunghawi teh,
pha han ngaipoungnae hmuen koe a phakhai.
Oe taminaw niyah BAWIPA hawinae hoi
taminaw hanelah kângairu hno
a sak e naw dawkvah, lunghawilawk
dei awh haw boipawiteh khe.
Tamimaya a kamkhuengnae koehai
ama teh tawm awh naseh.
Kacuenaw hmalah hai
pholen awh naseh.
Ama ni palangpui hah ayawn lah a coung sak teh,
tui hah talai kaphui e lah a coung sak.
Bangtelah tet pawiteh,
a thung kaawm e yonnae kecu dawk,
ram kahawi teh palawi talai lah ouk a coung sak.
Ayawn hah tuikamuemnae lah a coung sak teh,
ramkenaw hah tui onae hmuen lah a coung sak.
Khosaknae hmuen khopui lah a kangdue thai nahan,
vonkahlamnaw hah ao sak.
Moikapap a paw thai nahanelah,
misur takha a sak awh.
Yawhawi a poe teh moikapap a pung sak.
A paca e saringnaw kahma hane pasoung hoeh.
Repcoungroenae hoi runae,
pankângainae kecu dawk rahnoumnae hoi,
raphoe lah ao navah,
a tami bawinaw koe, pacekpahleknae a pha sak teh,
lamthung ohoehnae kahrawngum vah, a kâva sak.
Hottelah hoi tami ka roedeng e hah
runae tangkom dawk hoi hmuen rasangnae koe
a tawm teh, saringhu patetlah imthung a sak pouh.
Tamikalannaw ni a hmu awh navah,
a lunghawi awh. Payonnae ka sak pueng teh
pahni tabuem pouh lah ao.
A lungkaang pueng ni hete hnonaw heh
a pâkuem awh vaiteh,
BAWIPA lungpatawnae hah a thai panuek awh han.
